topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting histopathology practical observations to cellular transformation and outlining the core learning objectives of the lecture.

topics.label: Discovery and experimental evaluation of transforming genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical investigation of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional classifications and genetic mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the roles of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes in cell cycle control and examine how different mutation types alter cellular phenotypes.

topics.label: Origins and cellular manifestations of sequence and chromosomal instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how defects in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate genetic instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep tumor progression, hereditary predisposition, and tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the sequential acquisition or germline inheritance of mutations drives tumor initiation, malignant progression, and therapy resistance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with reading recommendations and administrative remarks about upcoming lectures.
